nodes.title: Step 1: Staging
widgets_values:
📍 Step 1 — 3D Set Setup
"industrial_ruin.json" preset is loaded. Both actors will perform inside this warehouse environment.

nodes.title: Step 2: Record Actor 1
widgets_values:
🚶 Step 2 — Record Human (Actor 1)
Click "Record" and move the human character across the stage with W, A, S, D keys.

nodes.title: Step 3: Record Actor 2 with Ghost Replay
widgets_values:
🐕 Step 3 — Record Quadruped (Actor 2)
Click "Record" to control the quadruped. You will see a live ghost replay of Actor 1 for synchronized choreography!

nodes.title: Step 4: Direct Multi-Actor Scene
widgets_values:
🎬 Step 4 — Multi-Actor Camera Cuts
When all actors are recorded, add live cuts along the timeline framing both actors, then hit Queue / Render.

nodes.title: Step 5: Output & AI Video Reference
widgets_values:
💾 Step 5 — Output & AI Video Reference

Saves the combined multi-actor synchronized sequence as a 720p MP4.

Use this VIDEO as reference with:
- Seedance 2.5 / Seedance 2.0 Fast (Reference-to-Video / I2V)
- MiniMax H3 Reference-to-Video

Prompt your visual style in the AI model and let Scene-Camera-Action handle the choreography and camera angles!
